subject: general
question: ______ of the Constitution of India deals with Panchayats.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Part IX.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Panchayati Raj Institution (PRI), a form of rural local self-government, is utilized in India.**
 
• The management of local affairs by elected local authorities is known as local self-government.
 
• The **73rd Constitutional Amendment Act,** passed in 1992, gave PRI constitutional protection in order to promote democracy at the local level and give it responsibility for the nation's rural development.
 
• The Constitution has **a new section IX with 16 articles and the Eleventh Schedule** thanks to the **Constitution (73rd Amendment) Act of 1992**.
 
 
• The **Gram Sabha** is envisioned in the 73rd Amendment as the cornerstone of the **Panchayat Raj System,** performing duties and exercising authority delegated to it by the State Legislatures.
